messages.subject: Thank you, Veloria Bay Foundation
messages.body:
Dear Veloria Bay Foundation,

Thank you for your $350,000 gift on April 15, 2025. Gifts like yours are how Miami's community foundation shows up for this city.

From The Miami Foundation's work: The Miami Foundation reported that Give Miami Day had grown into the largest single-city giving day in the country.

A story we're proud of: The Miami Foundation's partnership with McDermott Will & Schulte brought pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, providing 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.
Where gifts go: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 in rapid-response support for Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.
How the Foundation is doing: The Miami Foundation reported that Give Miami Day had grown into the largest single-city giving day in the country.

There's no ask in this note. We simply wanted you to know your support matters.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team

Where gifts go: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 in rapid-response support for Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.
How the Foundation is doing: The Miami Foundation reported that Give Miami Day had grown into the largest single-city giving day in the country.

If you have questions or ideas, simply reply to this email. We'd love to hear from you.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team
